translation:
It seems we've ended up with quite the
unbalanced lineup once again, huh…

Well, I can't deny that this group won't have
trouble preventing Haruhi's rampage.

So? What are we going to do from here on
out?
That's obvious! An on-scene investigation!

Madam Brigade Chief was in a good mood, with
an exuberant smile plastered on her face.

I don't know what she thinks is so worth
getting excited about…
And by that, you mean class 1-9, I presume?

Right! Thinking about it logically, assuming
class 10 exists, it'd have to be next to class 9.

Three people create the wisdom of Manjushri,
so four must mean hyper Manjushri wisdom!
Our scene is just over there. Let's go!

Haruhi lumbered over like a yeti striding
through the snow.

I'm begging you, don't find anything that'll
cause me trouble…

Nagato, is it okay for her to go near the
site?

If she finds the aforementioned impossible
classroom, it'll cause quite a ruckus.
There is a chance of discovery.

However, I will conceal it to the best of my
ability.

Sorry it's always like this, but you're the only
one I can rely on.
Understood.

Kyon! And Yuki! What are you doing?! Hurry
up and get over here you two!

Yes, yes, heading over right away, of course.
Good grief…

I don't think there's anything I need to
clarify. We're outside class 1-9…

In other words, the danger zone for the
sudden appearance of that class 1-10.
Hmm, the plate still says class 9.
Naturally. Because "class 10” doesn't exist.
It exists, I'm sure of it.

We came here to find it, so hurry up and look
around.

We've been tasked to investigate without any
sort of how-to guide.

Yuki, don't you feel some kind of mysterious
power? Like, the spiritual kind?

Haruhi, why is it that you're operating under
the assumption that Nagato…
…can even sense that kind of occult energy?

For some reason, it seems like she can,
doesn't it?

You wouldn't be wrong to be frightened by the
fact that she's not entirely incorrect.
…Nothing particular.

Really? Not even some kind of uncanny
presence?
Nothing.

Could it just be that the computer society
was mistaken after all? With it being so dark…

That might be the case, but we can't say for
sure.

Besides, it's the ironclad rule of the SOS
Brigade to expect the more exciting option!

Another needless rule. Although I'm sure the
one who thought it up will forget soon anyways.

The computer society's testimonies are
unreliable. We should look for other witnesses.

Then we can get out of this troublesome
place, which would do me a big favor.

If you mean a new testimony, Mikuru's already
getting that ready for us right now.
…Huh? Wait a second.

What is it? Did you notice another mysterious
presence or something?

Not that. Mikuru. Right now she's alone in the
computer society, you know.
Indeed, that's the duty she was assigned.
All alone, with the computer society…
I'm a little… worried.
What are you worried about?

You know how cute Mikuru is? She's gone off
to that room full of boys, you know?

I wouldn't consider that much of a reason to
be worried.

Let me remind you that Asahina is a
respected upperclassman.

Well, no, she's actually a lovely time traveler
whose age is unclear.

Worst-case scenario, it would be a massive
issue! All thanks to my careless supervision!

Worst-case… happening to Asahina…? That's
too absurd—as if that could ever happen.

But hold on, there's certainly something
about Haruhi's point I simply can't ignore.

Even I can tell as much—Asahina's extreme
cuteness is an objective truth.

If those computer society boys flock around
her… if by any chance that comes to pass…

…we'll have an instant brawl. The whole SOS
Brigade will end up in one big war party.

The computer society is in the old building, so
it's quite far.

If we are to go there, it would be best to
hurry.

I see. This is our excuse to get Haruhi away
from the scene…
Let's go. I'm worried about Asahina.
That's not what you were saying before.

I've reconsidered. The computer society is
solely made up of boys, after all.

It's probably nothing, but I can imagine them
wanting to spite us.

Whether it's spite or not, I definitely think
they hold a grudge.
We stole a brand-new PC from them after all.

Everyone, let's hurry over to the computer
society!

Either way, I'm grateful for the chance to
leave this place.

Asahina, I'm on my way, so I beg that nothing
happens to you…

With speed that would even turn a cheetah
pale, we returned to the old building.

And when we revisited the computer society
room…
[#SK0Fuueeh]… Waaaaa…
Wha-?!

The first thing I saw was, undoubtedly,
Asahina crying.
A-Asahina?!

The hell?! computer society!! What did you do
to Mikuru?!
…Waaah… ah… Kyon… Suzumiya…

Whoever's responsible for this, show yourself!
President!
Wh-what's going on? You guys again?

What the hell is this supposed to be?! I'll get
real violent if you don't have a good answer!
Huh? What are you sayi—

Tell us what happened here. Why is Asahina
crying—
Who cares why?! Mikuru's crying, y'see?!

We'll give 'em the death penalty! The most
ultimate of the ultimate punishments!
U-uh… Ummm…

What are you guys going on about with all
this inexplicable nonsense?

We have nothing to do with the fact she's
crying…

So you did do something?! That's right isn't
it?! I won't let you get away with it!
Wha… H-hey… [#SK0I] can't breathe—

Haruhi continued to press the president,
choking him with his own tie.

Nice one, Haruhi! Just this once, I fully
support your actions!

Now go on and confess. What kind of sick act
have you been trying to pull?
[#SK0N]-[#skN]-nothing… [#SK0Ekkk]
Then, in that very instant—

An annoying electronic sound suddenly rang
out. It sounds like energy draining… What is it?

P-p-p-president?! The power… [#SE004The] power
has…!

All the PCs… They all shut down
simultaneously…
Gah! W-what did you say…?

Miss Suzumiya, it's rather difficult to say this,
but…
Please, take a look by your feet.
My feet? Hmm? What is it?

Rolling by Haruhi's feet was a disconnected
plug.

It seems like Miss Suzumiya's feet got caught
on it, causing the power loss…
N-no way! The data is all gone!
Here as well. Everything's blank…!
Th-that… That can't be…
U-um… Kyon…

Asahina, are you okay?! Haruhi will handle the
computer society's punishment—

I'm crying because, um… I tripped in the
hallway over there.
Huh?

So, um… The computer society people didn't do
anything wrong…

I fell and hit the tip of my nose, so it really
hurt…
So, these guys are innocent?
Yes…

[#SE004W]-we said as much, didn't we?! That we didn't
do anything!
Ahh… Oh, well um… Sorry.

So what are you going to do about all our lost
data?!

Well that's… How do I put it? It's Haruhi's
personal blunder, so…
So what. It was super misleading.

I totally thought you'd attacked Mikuru, so of
course I went a little berserk.

If I just put the plug back in where it was,
everything's fine, right? Here.

The whirring of electronics filled the air as
computers booted up… or rather, restarted.
Lost data cannot be recovered.

Well, a bunch of active computers were
abruptly shut down after all…
[#SK0Aaaaahhhhhhhhhhh]…

The club president and his members were all
staring dumbfounded at the rebooting PCs.
…I know how you feel, computer society.

Looks like this was a total waste of time. Also,
all that shouting made me thirsty.

Let's head back to the clubroom at once.
Come on, Mikuru.
Hwuh? O-okay… But…

Everything's fine. Just come back to the
clubroom and make some tea.
O-okayyy.

Seems like the computer society intends to
leave it at that. You're truly a demon, Haruhi.
The data is… All our data is…

Either Taniguchi or Kunikida once said:
"Don't get involved with Haruhi Suzumiya!”

Sorry, computer society. Just think of it as
bad luck and accept it.

The members of the computer society were
considerably dispirited, or so it seemed.
It'd be weird if they weren't.
So, where's our ringleader gone off to?
Clubroom. Accompanied by Mikuru Asahina.

Pretty carefree of her, leaving without even
a word of apology…

I suppose it's best we offered them an
apology ourselves.

Even at the best of times, our history leaves
them with no choice but to hold a grudge.
What do you think? Shall I go ahead with it?

Alternatively, you have the option of asking
Miss Nagato.

Making Nagato go by herself would be cruel,
so I'll just handle it on my own.

But if it's a girl, they won't be as angry, don't
you think?
Huh, good point…
It's fine.
Hmm…

I don't think it would look good on me as a man
if I sent Nagato by herself…
What should I do?
Sorry Koizumi, but I'm gonna leave it to you.

I understand. Then please wait here—I'll be
just a moment.
I can't just wait in the clubroom?

Indeed—I actually have an idea, and it
requires both of your cooperation…
Got it.
Well then, I'll be seeing you momentarily.

Koizumi sprinted off to the computer society
room.
…Is he gonna be okay?
Then, after a little while…
Sorry for making you wait.
That was quick. You're already done?
Indeed. I left them with a humble apology.

They were still completely aghast with hollow
expressions on their faces, but…

They simply accepted it and nodded in
resignation.

How should I put it… A deeply pitiful computer
society.
…Nagato, can I leave it to you?
Yes.
I will apologize.

Nah, I'll be the one to do it. I'm not gonna make
you go in there by yourself.

If you don't mind, I just want you to be with
me, that's all.
Understood.
I will stay beside you.
Sorry.

Koizumi, you should head back to the clubroom
and keep Haruhi company.
Actually, I'll be waiting here.

I've got something I want to put into action,
and I need the two of you to help.
Put into action? What is it?
I'll explain everything later.

He gave the usual suspicious smile, seeming to
suggest some deeper meaning.
Alright. We'll be back as soon as possible.
Of course. I await your return.
Let's go, Nagato.

With that said and done, Nagato and I
reentered the computer society room…

It only took a few minutes. Before we knew it,
we were right back out.
How was it?

Uh… How should I put it? It was like
apologizing to an empty husk.
The computer society accepted our apology.

You say "accepted,” but it felt more like they
just nodded with their souls still yet to return.

Well, we more or less got the idea across. I
suppose that'll probably good enough.

Incidentally, Nagato softly bowed her head
with me when we apologized. Sorry, Nagato.

So, you said you wanted our help with
something. What is it?

Indeed. I'll explain, but we should go
somewhere else first.

Koizumi glanced at the SOS Brigade clubroom.
So it's about Haruhi, huh?

Let's head to the third floor of the main
building.

The third floor of the main building? You want
to go back to class 1-9?

There might be a way to deceive Miss
Suzumiya.
You want to trick Haruhi…?

I'll explain as we go. Let's hurry before she
catches on.

Koizumi's plan was incredibly simple. 
A befitting trick for a fraud.

You want us to tamper with the class plates,
offsetting everything from 1-6 to 1-9…?

That's right. The plate of class 8 where 7
should be, and 7 where 6 should be.
…What about the remaining class 9?

Exactly. Where class 9's plate was will be no
plate, number, nothing at all.
In other words, one might call it class 1-10.

That's such a simple trick, isn't it? Surely
Haruhi would catch on?

She probably would. In fact, I'm doing this
under the assumption that she will notice.
…What do you mean?

Think of it like this. It'll look like the result of
someone's prank.
So what?
Don't you understand?

I don't, in fact, understand. Also, I don't
appreciate being tested like this.

Sorry about that. What I'm trying to say is
simply this.

What the computer society witnessed was
merely a prank…

That is to say—it was no more than trickery
from the start.
…I see.

Someone set it up as a joke, and the
computer society fell for it…

It would mean that both parties have
fabricated the non-existent classroom.

You've really thought this through. Haruhi
really might just accept such an explanation.

And be mad about it. Hopefully it won't be
directed towards the computer society again.
Got it. What do you want us to do?

Let's first take down these plates then. Do
you mind starting from class 6?
I'll start from class 9.

What about Nagato? Surely she won't be able
to reach?
Height is not an issue.
I have another method.

…Saying so, Nagato raised both her hands
toward the class 6 plate. What's she planning?
…Nagato, what are you doing?
Destroying the plate.
Huh?

Direct contact is not required for
disassembly.
Whoa whoa whoa, hold on just a second!

We're not destroying them, just taking them
down!
The class 6 plate is unnecessary.

I suppose if we're just offsetting them, you're
not wrong. But still…

We'll have to put them back on later, so don't
break it. Just taking it off will be fine.
Understood. I will remove it.

If you could, that'd be great. Oh, you can use
my back as a stool.

I squat down and lend my back and shoulders
for Nagato to use as a platform.

Nagato's lightweight body put a moderate
amount of pressure on my back.
Remain still.
Yeah, got it.
Then, in that moment…
My phone dared to ring at a time like this.

Answering the phone in this posture is a little
tricky, but…
Uh, hello?
Well?! What are you doing slacking off?!
Oh, it's Haruhi… Geh. What is it?

Don't give me that! It's been ages, but you're
still not back yet!

Ah, we ended up busy with various things, like
patching things up with the computer society.

Even though Mikuru went out of her way to
make delicious tea…
It's already gone cold!
Damn, that's seriously unfortunate.

Whatever, just get back here this instant!
You have three minutes! I'm counting!

We can barely make it even if we run as fast
as we can… Don't be so unreasonable, Haruhi.
What happened?

A call from Haruhi. Return to the clubroom at
once, she says.
At once?
Are you finished taking those down?
No, I was just about to.
Nagato, is the class 6 plate off yet?
I can remove it at any moment.

It seems I spent too long explaining…
What should we do?

If we just hang around, Haruhi will probably
come hunt us down.
I'm sure of it. For the time being—
Let's just take off the class 6 plate.
Understood.

Although, it rather loses its significance if
it's only class 6…
Maybe we can use it for something later.

We should at least be able to use it as
evidence of foul play.
It is off.
Nice, good work. I'll look after that.

Let's head back before Haruhi leaves the
clubroom.

What a shame. I truly thought it was a good
idea…

You're right. We might still have a chance,
but for now we'll make a tactical retreat.

If Haruhi came and found us like this, we'd be
in for it deep.

Putting this plan on hold and returning to the
clubroom is our best move.

What a shame. If we had only ten minutes
more, we could've achieved our goal…

Let's think up another move. For now, we
should hurry back.
I suppose it can't be helped.
Leave it to Koizumi
Rely on Nagato
At least do class 6
Give up and return to the clubroom
